acceptance.given: S10, S15, and S40 verification is composed with the declared fixtures and their documented roles.

oracle.expected: The executed verification report records each fixture only in its declared role and derives behavior evidence from executed assertions; fixture existence alone cannot satisfy the result.
forbidden: A fixture file being present is accepted as behavior evidence.
A fixture is repurposed outside its declared role.
oracle.observable: The verification report contains executed assertion outcomes plus role-bounded fixture references, with no presence-only evidence.

acceptance.then: the fixture-role and evidence report is evaluated
acceptance.when: During composition and evaluation of the S10, S15, and S40 verification.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Reject verification when fixture presence is used as a behavior proof or a fixture is used beyond its declared role.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce role-bounded use of the declared S10, S15, and S40 fixtures and require executed assertions as the behavior evidence source.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert only the role/evidence enforcement changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Fixture-role validation moves from presence-or-reuse ambiguity to executed-assertion evidence with declared-role enforcement.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when every referenced fixture is role-bounded and the evidence contains executed assertion results; otherwise fail.

acceptance.given: The S10, S15, and S40 test-author entries are frozen with declared filenames and path bindings.

oracle.expected: The frozen manifest preserves each exact test filename and matching planned_new_files, execution_snapshot_paths, and allowed_write_paths entries, while production owners are absent from frozen test snapshots.
forbidden: An alternate test filename is introduced.
A declared path entry is changed or generalized.
A production owner appears in execution_snapshot_paths.
oracle.observable: Manifest comparison reports exact filename/path equality and a disjoint production-owner versus snapshot-path set.

acceptance.then: the frozen path-binding manifest is evaluated
acceptance.when: When preparing, freezing, or probing the S10, S15, and S40 entries.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Reject any filename drift, path-binding mismatch, or production-owner inclusion in frozen test snapshots.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve exact selector filenames and all declared path bindings while keeping production owners outside frozen snapshots.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No state/schema migration; restore the prior frozen path-binding manifest and test-author files.

slice_hint.state_transition: Path metadata remains exact and ownership boundaries remain disjoint through freeze and probe.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when all three exact filenames and path lists match the frozen declarations and no production owner is a snapshot path.

acceptance.given: S12 behavior probing is requested and scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s12.py is authored as the declared real selector target.

oracle.expected: Running the exact selector executes S12 behavior assertions and produces a behavior-test result from those assertions.
forbidden: CLI help, a schema file, a capability descriptor, or an old receipt is substituted for the S12 behavior test.
oracle.observable: The pytest invocation reports collected and executed S12 assertions with a terminal test result.

acceptance.then: the exact S12 selector is invoked

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S12 behavior selector must fail when it is absent, substituted by a non-test artifact, or produces no executed real assertions.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind S12 verification to the exact pytest selector and require its real assertions to execute.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; revert the S12 selector binding and test implementation only.

slice_hint.state_transition: S12 moves from unexecuted behavior verification to an executed real-test result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when the exact command executes S12 assertions and emits a terminal pytest result; otherwise fail.

acceptance.given: Quick Dev prepares the S37 slice before freezing and probing.

oracle.expected: scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s37.py exists as an authored executable test or fixture with assertions before freeze and probe.
forbidden: The S37 test file is absent.
A declaration or placeholder stands in for a real test or fixture.
oracle.observable: The pre-freeze authoring check reads the S37 path and confirms executable test or fixture content.

acceptance.then: the S37 pre-freeze authoring gate runs
acceptance.when: When Quick Dev prepares the S37 slice for freezing and probing.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Reject freeze/probe preparation if test_s37.py is missing or contains only a declaration/placeholder rather than executable assertions.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require Quick Dev to author the real S37 selector target before freeze and probe, with executable assertions available for later execution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; remove only the S37 authoring gate/test changes on rollback.

slice_hint.state_transition: S37 changes from an unavailable selector target to an authored executable test or fixture ready for freezing and probing.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when test_s37.py exists before freeze/probe and contains executable assertions; otherwise fail closed.
